commits.message:
fix(render): a request's wait ends on the next stamp, and a redraw that reads no newer world state ends it as stale

Review pass 3 on the request wait: the host's own record of what reached the
renderer is deleted. Mailbox order puts a stamp's delivery ahead of the
redraw, and a renderer that refused it fails the redraw, so the record only
re-answered both and missed paths to the renderer.

fix(render): the world state a request's own context carries wakes the waits on older draws, and a frame answers only a recipient that is still there

Review pass 2 on the request wait: what landed at the renderer moves for the
context turn's world state too, the one admission rule for a frame covers
every ending, a draw that throws during the close is the renderer's failure,
and a wait its own signal ended says so.

fix(render): a request's draws end as one typed result, and what landed at the renderer never moves back

Review pass 1 on the request wait: the loop's ending is one value, an
abandoned draw is no throw, a rejected delivery tells the waiting request
why, the deferral spelling is one call per deferred built-in, and the wait
returns what it waited on.

fix(render): a request waits for exactly what its frame draws pending, and an unanswered source draws as pending

The draw reports what it still owes with every frame (settled, owed names, or stalled by a failed stamp), each with the seq of the world state it drew. The host waits for that and nothing it recomputes, redraws when a later world state reaches the renderer, and ends on a draw that owes nothing, a stalled stamp, a turn that threw or was refused, or the client's deadline, recording what held a wait that ran out. Text, file and json variables are pending until their first run answers; their fallback stands in only for a run that read nothing. Today's day sums and the branch's PR draw deferred, which no request waits on.
fix(daemon): review pass 1 — bounded flag on answering, backstop phase named by whose clock, linkTo and click-event helpers shared

fix(daemon): a TIMEOUT to a click means it ran nothing, and url-handle and the click helpers act on that

A click request read in time is answered with its own outcome instead of
being bounded by the request guard, so a TIMEOUT now means the frame was read
after the guard fired and the click was refused at its turn. url-handle tells
a refused click to be clicked again and a click its own clock cut off that the
outcome is unknown. The e2e click helper sends again on TIMEOUT and no longer
reads the daemon log for an outcome.

docs(design): the design docs and memory files say what the code does now

host-and-renderer.md points at the renderer interface instead of copying it,
states Address as object keys with arrays addressed whole, and describes the
host's start and environment as they are (no LaunchAgent is written; launchd
stays planned). The inventory cites files that exist and counts the verbs the
code declares. Memory drops identifiers, the removed tmux status line, click
restart and Doctor-as-living lines, and states a diagnostic's identity as
producers name it.

chore(release): set `package.json` to 1.236.10
